question: What structural group and measure are applied on the platform?
premises: A sixfold group beginning with the base is specified.
Its measure is to be applied on the platform.
inference: The sixfold structural group beginning with the base is to be measured on the platform.
uncertainties: The six members of the ṣaḍvarga are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: On the platform, one should apply the sixfold group beginning with the base according to its measure.
